Selected projects

A selection of projects grouped by skill. Each entry presents a complete project through one representative visual, its challenge, deliverables and the value delivered.

01 · B2B Content / Finance

Lead magnet and data storytelling

Editorial strategy · Benchmarking · B2B copywriting · Conversion

Designing a long-form guide around a diffuse operational problem
Cashfeed · Invoice processing automation

The project quantifies the cost of manual invoice processing, compares it with an automated model and connects the demonstration to the Cashfeed value proposition.

Challenge

The unit cost of an invoice appears low, yet accumulated data entry, approvals, delays and errors create an annual burden that is difficult to perceive.

Deliverables

An 11-page B2B guide in Dutch, an international benchmark, volume-based scenarios, objection handling and a call to action.

Value delivered

The content frames the issue at €22K to €32K per year for 300 monthly invoices, then clearly links it to the Cashfeed automation promise.

Lead magnetData storytellingBenchmarkingB2B copywriting
02 · HR Tech / Content system

Useful content and paid social campaign

E-book · Candidate experience · Product campaign · Social media variations

Building a content system connected to a product campaign
Homerun · HR Tech / Candidate experience

A practical e-book and several paid social angles were connected around the ATS, candidate experience and the quality of recruitment communications.

Challenge

Recruiters need to manage a high volume of applications without losing clarity, consistency or empathy throughout the candidate experience.

Deliverables

A 10-page e-book, rejection email templates, campaign angles and paid social assets connecting the resource to the ATS.

Value delivered

Starting from an operational pain point made it possible to provide an immediately useful resource and make the product value proposition more tangible.

E-bookPaid socialHR TechContent system
03 · SaaS / Demand generation

Tool fragmentation and proof of concept

Positioning · Campaign concept · Use case · Conversion

Turning product complexity into a clear campaign promise
Evoqia · SaaS / Demand generation

Three campaign concepts were developed to promote a free proof of concept around one simple message: too many tools and no overview.

Challenge

Operational data is scattered across Excel, inboxes, ERP, CRM, PDFs and shared spaces.

Deliverables

Three square and vertical variations combining the value proposition, a view of the tools, a use case and a call to action for a free pilot.

Value delivered

The campaign reduces technical complexity to an immediately recognizable tension and gives the proof of concept a concrete entry point.

04 · Industrial B2B / Value selling

Total cost and long-term sales argument

Value selling · Product proof · ROI calculator · German campaign

Designing a value-selling campaign based on total cost
Blommaert · B2B industrial marketing

The German campaign is built around a calculator comparing the real cost of different materials over a thirty-year period.

Challenge

The initial purchase price hides maintenance and replacement costs, as well as the difference in value created over the long term.

Deliverables

Two square assets featuring product proof, a measurable benefit, a calculator preview and a call to action for a free comparison.

Value delivered

The campaign shifts the decision from a simple price comparison to total cost of ownership and makes the economic advantage measurable.

Industrial marketingROI calculatorValue sellingGerman

Employee engagement and content download

Lead magnet · Creative concept · Content proof · Acquisition

Creating a lead magnet around a sensitive HR question
Elli · HR / Lead generation

Two visual directions were developed around employee departure risk: a highly branded execution and a more editorial alternative.

Challenge

The campaign needed to surface a sensitive and immediately relevant question: are the best employees engaged or already halfway out the door?

06 · Expert content

Regulation and data visualization

Monitoring · Simplification · Information hierarchy · Thought leadership

Turning regulatory developments into a product timeline
Dstny · Expert B2B content

The social format connects several regulatory developments to their concrete effects on the product and its backlog.

Challenge

GDPR, eIDAS 2024 and the AI Act follow one another, but their operational impact remains difficult to understand for a non-specialist audience.

Deliverables

A compact timeline, prioritization of key dates and translation of each milestone into a product consequence.

Value delivered

The format makes regulatory monitoring immediately readable and connects the information to a concrete roadmap decision.

Designing a visualization of EU AI Act penalties
Holistic AI · Data visualization / AI governance

The social format makes the three fine levels defined by the EU AI Act directly comparable and easier to understand at a glance.

Challenge

Penalty levels combine absolute amounts and percentages of revenue, making their scale difficult to grasp quickly.

Deliverables

A data-led infographic, a vertical hierarchy and a summary of the €7.5M, €15M and €35M thresholds.

Value delivered

The work turns dense legal material into shareable content that immediately conveys risk exposure.

07 · B2C / Acquisition

Interactive quiz and decision support

Creative concept · Objection handling · Paid social variations · Conversion

Turning product hesitation into an acquisition quiz
E-commerce brand · B2C acquisition

The campaign starts from the uncertainty involved in choosing a garden shed and guides the audience toward a fast, engaging experience.

Challenge

The variety of styles, sizes and uses makes the choice difficult and prevents interest from becoming a concrete preference.

Deliverables

Three paid social variations featuring a choice architecture, visual answers, proof of use and a call to action for a 30-second quiz.

Value delivered

The campaign reduces decision effort, engages users through a simple interaction and creates a measurable conversion point.
